description: TACKLE COMMITMENT 2 - ANGLE TOLERANCE. 0x1441a8448: for ordinary carrier actions the AI will only tackle if its heading is within 22.5 deg of the ball. 30 deg lets defenders challenge from a wider arc instead of only head-on. Same-length disp32 re-aim. NOTE 22.5 is also the kick-error constant - this is a DIFFERENT instruction; the cell 0x14676e980 itself is not touched.
